verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs say a `semantic_text` field automatically generates embeddings at index time using a configured model, with no model settings or inference ingest pipelines to set up (elastic-docs-1, elastic-docs-23). Models can be deployed directly in Elasticsearch, used as external or hosted embedding models, or configured through the inference API, and the platform advertises GPU inference in one API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that query text is automatically embedded at search time, plus a named list of Elastic-managed default embedders and independent hands-on corroboration.
